title: ASD LabSpec 4 high-res -> standard-res, v0.1 (blur per detector, one absorbance gain; provisional; superseded by 0.2.0)

operator.note: inside each detector segment of the scan's own joins (the join wavelength belongs to the lower segment); taps to radius ceil(4 sigma), renormalised within the segment, never crossing a join; sigma from the published bandwidths (FWHM 10 nm standard vs 6 nm high-res in SWIR; VNIR equal)

A = log10(1/max(R, 1e-6)); A' = g*A + c per detector segment (VNIR, SWIR1, SWIR2); R' = 10^(-A'). The offsets only keep the displayed absorbance continuous at the training joins; every derivative-based output ignores them.

provenance.summary: Transfer v0.1 (provisional, superseded by 0.2.0): nominal Gaussian blur per detector, then ONE absorbance gain for all detectors.
provenance.fitted_on: 40 paired scans of the same archaeological bones on a high-resolution and a standard-resolution LabSpec 4 (two unit pairs, 20 pairs each; spots not marked, so pairs are not same-spot); all 40 pairs in the fit
provenance.known_problem: one scalar gain is not adequate across the NIR: cross-unit, C-H 1689 reads -14% and C-H 1728 -11% low, Ryder 2045 +6.7% high; kept so results made with it stay interpretable
